name: object-type-reference-test-19fd51d776/object-type-reference-1-negative-e.bal
spec_references: Module-level declarations: Class definition — Supports `object-field`, `method-defn` and `object-type-inclusion` members
reason: The case depends on Employee2 including Person2 within an object type descriptor (`*Person2;`), propagating fields and method obligations into the subsequent Manager2 class inclusion and its asserted errors. Object-type inclusion is explicitly supported for class members, but is absent from the supported object-type-descriptor member list. This essential construct is therefore outside the documented subset.
unsupported_constructs: Object-type inclusion inside an object type descriptor: `type Employee2 object { *Person2; ... }`
test_design_notes: Negative rejection of class inclusions and related field accesses would otherwise be in scope; illegal code alone does not make this a feature case.
